_meta.cv_authority_rule: The CV is primary source material. A role is not omitted, downgraded or doubted because it cannot be found in this repository, on X, on GitHub or in a search engine. Roles that are less visually impressive are not dropped.
rendering_rules: Group by year rather than drawing a single continuous timeline.
Do not fabricate continuity between jobs. Gaps remain gaps.
Do not create a decorative continuous spine that falsely implies uninterrupted employment.
Show approximate dates as visibly approximate. Where dates are missing, present them non-misleadingly — 'date not supplied' rather than an inferred range.
Use past tense for historical roles; do not present historical radio work as current employment.
